name: Galfar Engineering & Contracting
meta: Galfar Engineering & Contracting: multi-disciplined engineering, contracting and construction in Oman since 1972.

hero.title: Building Oman since 1972
hero.lede: One of the largest multi-disciplined engineering, contracting and construction companies in the Sultanate of Oman, delivering energy, civil and infrastructure projects.

about.title: Multi-disciplined, from design to operation
body: Galfar has been established in Oman since 1972. Its work spans engineering, procurement and construction for energy and industrial plants, buildings and environmental works, and roads, airports, seaports, dams and water networks, including operation and maintenance.

points.title: Operation & maintenance
points.text: Galfar also operates and maintains several of the facilities it builds.

points.title: Quality, safety & environment
points.text: QHSSE is one of the group's dedicated support units.

points.title: Iconic projects
points.text: Yibal Khuff, Salalah Airport, the Boushar-Amirat Road and Duqm Fishery Port.

services.title: Business units
services.intro: Three business units cover energy, civil and infrastructure work.

items.title: Energy & Industrial
items.text: Engineering, construction and procurement for oil and gas plants, petrochemical and manufacturing facilities, power generation and power grids.

items.title: Civil & Environmental
items.text: Landmark buildings, MEP services, and wastewater treatment plants and networks, including operation and maintenance.

items.title: Infrastructure
items.text: Roads, bridges, airports, seaports, dams, water treatment plants and water networks, including operation and maintenance.

highlights.title: Iconic projects
highlights.intro: Projects the group features on its homepage.
